hook: Drag an animal's eye across a meadow: ultraviolet bullseyes for a bee, red-green blindness for a dog, eagle-sharp detail, owl night vision and a rattlesnake's heat sense. Then look inside each eye.
outcome: Explain how animals' eye and sense structures (compound eyes, cones and rods, tube-shaped eyes, heat-sensing pits, eye placement) help them survive, and model how light reflected from objects enters the eye so we can see them
sources: Dog color vision simulated with the Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes (2009) deuteranopia matrix
Bee view uses the standard false-color convention (ultraviolet shown as purple)
Fields of view: typical published values; they vary
